newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 18.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 18.

text.p: These are the main headlines reported by Kuku Radio on Wednesday at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
-A court case involving the indebted Ookean fishing fleet company has started in the United States. -The Pro patria
union is disappoited in the Reform party over the Reform party's agreement with the Centre party leading to the appointment of a new mayor for Tartu city.
